dedupe_keys.name: database of industrial environmental disasters and non violent protest oecd countries 1907 to 2024

description: This database records acute industrial environmental disasters in OECD countries and the peaceful protests that followed them. The Harvard Dataverse record says it covers four event types (oil spills, chemical spills, mining leaks and nuclear accidents) across 27 countries from 1907 to 2024, with the occurrence, size, pollution source and type and location of each incident, plus the occurrence, size and location of protests in response. It was published in December 2025 (version 1.0) by Miriam Matejova under CC0 1.0, free to download as one XLSX workbook of about 111 KB with a PDF metadata note. Coverage is OECD countries only. Caveats: inclusion criteria and sources are described only in the PDF, which was not read, and protest data reflect media coverage. For simulation it gives a long record of industrial spill and leak events with a social response layer, useful for event frequency and consequence assumptions and for the social side of industrial disaster scenarios. Related catalogue records include the ARIA accident database, eMARS and the US CSB investigations.
